question: On which date and toward which direction must one proceed in the month of Māgha?
premises: The time is the seventh day of the month of Māgha.
The prescribed action is to proceed.
The direction specified is the southern quarter.
inference: On the seventh day of Māgha one should proceed toward the southern direction.
plain_english: On the seventh day of the month of Māgha, one should go toward the southern direction.
